Question 4
?

Lucy reads 6 pages of her new book each day. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the number of pages P(t) Lucy has left to read? Assume that the time t is measured in days.

a
 dPdt=P−6
b
 dPdt=−6P
c
 dPdt=−6
d
 dPdt=6P
e
 dPdt=6
